_comment: Anthropic API list prices, USD per million tokens. Used to value Claude Code usage
at what the same work would have cost on the API. On a subscription this is NOT what
you pay - see the plan panel in the dashboard for actual spend.
Each model holds a LIST of periods so a price change never rewrites history:
the aggregator picks the entry whose 'from' is the latest date <= the day being
priced. Claude Sonnet 5 is on introductory pricing through 2026-08-31, which is
exactly why this file is dated rather than flat - a single number would silently
reprice every past day the moment the promotion ends.
cache_read / cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h are multipliers on the INPUT price.
They are not optional detail: cache reads are ~99% of all input tokens here, so
pricing them at 1.0 instead of 0.1 overstates the total by roughly ten times.
